fusions.name: Polyp Touch
fusions.desc: Lashes stinging polyps at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target is left [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fringing Reef
fusions.desc: Grows a reef 5 tiles long out from your shell for 6 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Calcify
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 30% for 12 seconds, and your water resistance rises by 15%.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal for 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
